bull_bear.body:
- "Adequately capitalized": Capital Adequacy of 18.5% at Jun-26 (Tier I 16.5%, Tier II 2.1%) versus 20.6% at Jun-25 and 18.8% at Mar-26; Debt/Equity at 5.00:1 versus 4.75:1 a year earlier.
- "Robust liquidity" — liquidity buffer of 14,650 at Jun-26 versus 10,100 at Jun-25; in addition to undrawn sanctioned lines, the Company held Cash/Liquid investments of over INR 14,650 crores.
- Broad-based liability mix of Rs 1,25,979 crore (FV/principal): Banks/FIs 67.2%, Insurance & Pension Funds 10.8%, FIIs & Corporates 9.5%, Mutual Funds 6.6%, Others 5.9%; 44% of the overall borrowing is at floating rate as of Jun'26.
- Dividend shown as 375% for FY26 with no dividend recorded for the quarters ended Jun-26 or Jun-25; Book Value stated at Rs. 184.7 at Jun-26 versus Rs. 168.0 at Jun-25.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Aspiration stated as "Most Trusted Financial Services Partner for Bharat", delivered via a Franchise Flywheel with three pillars: Relevance (where we participate), Reach (how we serve) and Responsible (how we safely compound).
- Claims "India's deepest Rural & Semi-urban Franchise" with last-mile customer proximity: 1,300+ branches and 6,000+ dealer coverage, 12M+ customers and 10+ OEMs.
- Part of the Mahindra Group (M&M holds 52.49% as on 30th June 2026), an Upper Layer Deposit taking NBFC with 30+ years of legacy and highest credit ratings 'AAA'; market capitalisation stated as 448 Bn (source: BSE website, as of July 20, 2026).
- Geographic footprint described as 27 States and 7 Union territories, 95%+ pin codes served, 1300+ branches/offices, 5,00,000+ villages served and 6,000+ dealers — "A deep-rooted commitment to empowering Bharat".
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [F31 milestones] Deck states forward milestones for F31: Credit Cost 1.3-1.7%, GS2+GS3 <10%, RoA 2.2-2.5% and PPC 3.2-3.5.
- [Group structure] Subsidiaries/JVs listed as MRHFL 98.43% (balance 1.57% with MRHFL Employee Welfare Trust and employees), MIBL 100% (wholly owned w.e.f. 22nd September 2023), Mahindra Ideal Finance PLC Sri Lanka 58.2%, MMIMPL and MMTPL 51% each (Manulife Investment Management Singapore holds 49%), Mahindra Finance USA LLC 49% (JV with a Rabobank group subsidiary), plus Mahindra Finance CSR Foundation.
- [Provisioning overlay] Stage 3 provisions include management overlays of Rs 635 Cr created in Q3 F26 and Rs 217 Cr created in Q4 F26; the deck flags that Q4FY26 credit cost and PAT are after this additional provisioning.
- [Exceptional item] FY26 PAT is stated as post exceptional item on account of labour code impact, with Exceptional Items of -117 for FY26 and nil in Q1FY27.
- [IRACP vs Ind-AS] Total provisioning under Ind-AS of 4,030 versus IRACP requirement of 2,444, a difference of 1,586 (Stage 1 and 2: 755; Stage 3: 831).
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services as an AAA-rated, Mahindra-Group-backed Upper Layer deposit-taking NBFC aspiring to be the "Most Trusted Financial Services Partner for Bharat", compounding through a "Franchise Flywheel" of Relevance (mobility, enterprise, household), Reach (physical + phygital + digital) and Responsible (risk discipline, financial resilience, trust & governance).
